extensionDescription.message: Organise Chrome tabs with your own LLM API.

settingsIntroduction.message: Choose the model Ark uses when you organise a window.

apiKeyHelp.message: Stored only in this Chrome profile.

baseUrlHelp.message: Use HTTPS, or loopback HTTP for a local model.

modelPlaceholder.message: Choose or type a model ID

modelHelp.message: Choose from the loaded list or type any model ID.

inputTokenLimitHelp.message: Leave blank to retry automatically with smaller batches only when the model rejects a long input.

classificationRequirementsHelp.message: Edit how tabs are grouped and named. Ark always adds its JSON and tab-ID constraints. Restore default changes only these requirements.

classificationRequirementsRequired.message: Enter classification requirements, or restore the defaults.

knowledgePlaceholder.message: Example: foo.internal is our project tracker, not a documentation website.

knowledgeHelp.message: Explain unfamiliar domains, terms, or projects. Sent in full with each classification request. Classification requirements take precedence over this background.

systemPromptHelp.message: Read-only preview of your current edits. Save to use them for all providers. Batches append existing group context at runtime.

promptCopyFailed.message: Could not copy automatically. The prompt is selected; copy it with your keyboard or context menu.

modelTestCost.message: Testing sends a minimal generation request and may incur a small charge.

modelsLoaded.message: $1 models loaded. You can still type another ID.

privacyNotice.message: Tab titles, full URLs, classification requirements, and Knowledge go directly to your selected provider. Ark has no server.

permissionDenied.message: Allow access to this provider, then try again.

unauthorised.message: The provider rejected this API key.

modelForbidden.message: This model refused the request. Choose another model or check its permissions.

rateLimited.message: The provider limit was reached. Try again later.

requestTimeout.message: The provider took too long to respond.

networkError.message: Ark could not reach the provider.

invalidProviderResponse.message: The provider returned an unreadable response.

inputTooLong.message: The system prompt or one tab is too long for this model. Shorten it or set a larger input limit.

nothingToOrganise.message: Open at least two unpinned tabs to organise them.

applyingGroups.message: Applying groups. Stop is unavailable until this step finishes or rolls back.

backgroundOrganising.message: Working in the original window. You can close this popup; the task will continue.

taskWindowScope.message: Original task window · pinned tabs excluded

organiseCancelled.message: Stopped. No tab-group changes were applied.

organiseInterrupted.message: The background task was interrupted. Check the original window before trying again.

taskConnectionLost.message: Display disconnected. The background task may still be running. Reconnect to check it.

sendingTabData.message: Sending tab titles and URLs to your provider.

organisedGroupCount.message: Created $1 tab groups; left $2 tabs ungrouped.

tabsChanged.message: Tabs changed while Ark was working. Run it again.

groupingFailed.message: Chrome could not apply every group. Your previous layout was restored where possible.

groupNameRequired.message: Enter a name for every selected group.
